description:
PR A only — durable capture and authorized access, not runtime consumption. Create/resolve Direct/Shared/Replicated transcripts and persist per-message associations from trusted facts before response-trigger decisions. Retain nonmentions without response; preserve existing explicit triggers; prevent echoes/duplicate public answers. Enforce transcript-path authorization for People/BO/history Action reads, shares, citations, attachments and exports; exclude private execution fields. Thread/root/local and bounded parent projections must not include siblings or bypass grants. Automatic agent hydration, steering, busy/finalizing lifecycle and execution-private writer wiring move to .30 (PR B), .5 and .16.
Files: Channels ingress/CommunicationBridge/JidoChatBridge, Engine IncomingMessageRouter/Conversations/authorized read APIs, People/BO/artifact consumers. Reuse existing accounts.fetch_history read operation; no parallel persistence/recall Action. Tests FIRST: passive persistence before gating, denied/nil access, isolation/idempotency, per-message email audience and safe projection; real internal DB/domain paths, external transport/model mocks only. Include Channels/Engine/API documentation in A. One outcome PR, no bead-specific PR; new E2E waits .12.

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.

comments.text: Preparation from preceding PR A slices: EmailBridge now stamps :email kind from configured email:imap bridge/provider, not an Incoming metadata claim; JidoChatBridge only stamps evidenced Mattermost/Telegram/Discord kinds. The remaining ingress work is NOT solved: Jido.Chat nonmention on_new_message wildcard currently returns :ok without Engine dispatch; mention/path policy still routes to admit_incoming legacy messages; canonical transcript creation/association and Person-grant checks are not yet wired. Engine Conversations.append_canonical_message/3 requires an existing transcript and trusted source; Facts/Strategy currently pure and no create-or-resolve transcript API exists. Before changing capture, design transactional target creation + shared/thread parent + per-recipient ownership, dedup against legacy Message UUID/ratings/traces, and authorization/grant reconciliation; do not duplicate a mention in legacy and canonical messages or mistake kind evidence for a grant. Reuse existing Conversations/TranscriptHistory/Strategy APIs; no new Action exposed to agents. No feature E2E until .12 approval.

PR A capture foundation remains uncommitted and NOT ingress-wired. Action reuse assessment: reused Engine Conversations.append_canonical_message/3 + TranscriptHistory.append/3 and History.Facts/Strategy association_targets rather than a parallel writer/Action. Extended Conversations.capture_canonical_message/3 as Engine-local atomic target-resolver/orchestrator; not an agent-tool Action because it requires internally attested provider, connector, source account, actor and per-message recipient People, and would be unsafe to expose to agent arguments. Inputs Facts + message attrs + trusted source; returns placement IDs/positions or errors; SQL writes transactional; same external ID/source_scope replay idempotent; nil ID distinct; changed email recipient set denied under a per-identity transaction lock. Seed direct participant grants once when parent is created, not on replay/new child; shared remains provider-grant-only; Replicated owned by individual Person. Isolated capture/transcript tests pass (23 tests, 2 properties), mix q passes. Still needed: connector-scoped recipient resolution, passive nonmention ingress, legacy message-ID reuse/cutover preserving UUID/rating/attachment/trace, authorized BO/API shares/citations/export readers, membership synchronization and full PR A integration. Do not treat this foundation as a completed .4 or as proof of authorized caller provenance. No feature E2E authored.

Capture foundation follow-up: verified against existing StrategyTest that Direct thread replies reuse the one parent transcript (not a child), while Shared threads get a child; corrected the new integration test and documentation without weakening existing assertions. Added regression tests for missing Person, unscoped email UID, nil external ID (distinct placements), changed email recipient replay, simultaneous conflicting audience replays, transaction rollback, direct provider grant revocation vs manual grant. SQL transaction advisory lock serializes same replicated source identity before checking existing audience. Current broad isolated affected suite: 371 tests, 6 properties, 0 failures; mix q passes. Ingress, consumer cutover, and identity/grant wiring remain outstanding for PR A.

title: [zaq-emb.4] PR A strategy-driven persistence, passive capture and authorized reads
